name: IC 3949 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 3949, an edge-on disk galaxy in the Coma cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ic3949-hubble
story: A jellyfish galaxy near the heart of the Coma cluster, being stripped of its gas as it moves, with star formation stirred up along its leading half.

claims.text: IC 3949 is an edge-on disk galaxy
It lies at the center of the Coma Cluster
It is a confirmed member of the Coma cluster
It is a jellyfish galaxy undergoing ram pressure stripping
It shows enhanced star formation on its leading half
Program 13777 targets IC 3949 to study ram pressure stripping of Coma spirals
